children: BRASILIA, Oct 14 (Reuters) - Services activity in Brazil grew 0.6% in August from August 2025 (BRSERV=ECI), statistics agency IBGE said. Economists had forecast a median rise of +1.1% in a Reuters poll.
Services activity fell 0.1% from July after seasonal adjustments.
